newsitem.title: FRANCE: French 96 deficit 330 bln Ffr on Maastricht basis.
newsitem.headline: French 96 deficit 330 bln Ffr on Maastricht basis.

text.p: The French 1996 public deficit calculated in line with Maastricht definitions was 330 billion francs, compared with 380 billion francs in 1995, which represents 4.2 percent of gross domestic product, a senior finance ministry official said on Tuesday.

The 1996 public deficit figure is lower than the 356 billion franc figure given earlier on Tuesday by National statistics insitute INSEE and is calculated to allow comparison with other European countries.

According to the Maastricht accounting rules, the government deficit was 287 billion compared with the 295 billion given in the national accounts while the social security deficit was 54 billion francs, rather than the 64 billion given by INSEE, the official said.
